column1: # WHAT THIS IS. The fix moved the in-scope denominator of 14 phase-1 candidate
# crates. For a crate a lane already reported DONE ("measured + exceptions ==
# in-scope SLOC"), a moved denominator means that equation no longer closes.
# This file names EVERY such line. Nothing here has been silently adjusted:
# no claim was flipped from done to not-done, and no exception row was authored
# on a lane's behalf (exception rows are a reviewed correctness assertion —
# exceptions.tsv governance: "rows enter by PR review only").
#   remeasure-inclusion  newly IN scope and never measured. The lane owes
#                        either a coverage line or a reviewed exception row.
#   remeasure-exclusion  newly OUT of scope. If the lane's measured set
#                        included any of these lines, both sides of its
#                        equation shrink. Mechanical: re-intersect the existing
#                        capture's covered sets with the new denominator
#                        — no instrument re-run, no solver time.
# proposed_class is a HINT for the owning lane, not a verdict and not counted.
# RESOLUTIONS (2026-07-31, fix/sloc-residue cleanup lane): every `owed` row
# below now carries an appended `|| RESOLVED ...` clause in its note column —
# measured re-exports for pg_lsn and adt_timestamp, exception rows filed on
# the closed lanes' behalf (marked class-precedent) for xid8funcs/jsonb/
# jsonpath, and mechanical whole-file recuts for the exclusions. Nothing here
